verdict_reason: The pool contains several highly aligned distribution platforms and festivals specifically geared toward completed, low-budget indie dramedies seeking global exposure without prior festival history.

ranked_candidates.name: Indie Rights
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: Indie Rights explicitly caters to independent features that lack top-tier festival pedigree, offering non-exclusive 80% revenue share distribution across major global platforms (TVOD/AVOD/SVOD) with no upfront expenses. Their catalog includes comedy and drama, aligning seamlessly with a low-budget coming-of-age dramedy.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Submit the completed feature and screener link through the Google Form on their distribution page for consideration.

ranked_candidates.name: I AM EIGA
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: Based in Brooklyn, I AM EIGA is a curated member-led platform and pitch-room system connecting indie filmmakers directly with acquisitions professionals, festival programmers, and cinephiles. It provides strong discovery and potential acquisition opportunities without requiring prior festival accolades.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Create a filmmaker profile and submit the 105-minute feature through the platform's portal for a 14-day review.

ranked_candidates.name: Los Angeles Indie Film Festival
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: This Los Angeles festival explicitly accepts feature-length submissions in any genre up to 120 minutes (fitting your 105-minute runtime), providing physical screening opportunities and industry networking for unreleased indie films.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Submit an active screener link with password and complete the entry form on their website.

ranked_candidates.name: LBR Film Distribution
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: LBR Film Distribution accepts completed feature films across multiple genres including drama and comedy via an online submission form, making it a viable general distribution avenue for an unrepresented indie feature.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Fill out their submission form with logline, synopsis, cast credits, and a secure 30-day active screener link.

ranked_candidates.name: FABA Films
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: FABA Films offers artist-driven self-distribution and festival streaming options where filmmakers retain 100% of ad revenue, serving as a solid fallback option for independent feature projects.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Submit an inquiry via their contact and submission form to explore non-exclusive self-distribution.

ranked_candidates.name: Invincible Entertainment
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: Invincible accepts submissions via Direct Acquisition and Distribution as a Service programs, though available details regarding genre preferences and acquisition criteria remain limited.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Review their acquisition submission guidelines on the official site and reach out to their acquisitions desk.

ranked_candidates.name: Berlin International Film Festival (Berlinale)
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: Berlinale is an A-list tier festival requiring high processing fees (€175) and currently notes ambiguity around entry submissions; it is generally an unrealistic launchpad for an unheralded low-budget feature with zero festival history.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Monitor official festival submission announcements before committing application fees.

ranked_candidates.name: Van Cleve Films
ranked_candidates.fit_reason: While Van Cleve offers flat-fee non-exclusive distribution for indie films, its current explicit intake focus is restricted to reality television programming.
ranked_candidates.action_needed: Hold off on submitting narrative feature projects until narrative film submissions reopen.

recommendation: Prioritize submitting directly to Indie Rights and I AM EIGA for direct distributor contact and platform discovery without relying on a costly festival run. Concurrently, submit to regional independent festivals like the Los Angeles Indie Film Festival to build initial exposure and local festival pedigree. Avoid spending submission fees on top-tier competitive international festivals like Berlinale at this stage.
